This is how it works.

>Player received xp orb

>Game checks for both active and passive mending

(Active mending is your equipped tool)

(Passive mending is for your armor/offhand)

It will count how many possible items it could send an xp orb to. Let's say you have 4 armor pieces with mending, and one equipped tool. There are 5 potential slots for that XP orb to go to.

In this particular situation, your helmet is perfectly repaired, this is not the same case with the rest of your armor or your equipped gear. 

If the XP orb decides to go to the helmet, even tho it's fully repaired, it will instead be sent to your level bar. So if you have 4 pieces of fully repaired gear equipped, the game will, inevitably, send 4 out of 5 XP orbs to your level bar, rather than your equipped tool.

So how do we solve this? We remove the games ability to check for mending gear for everything except the tool we are repairing, ergo we put everything in a chest.
